plugins.name: destreamed
plugins.description: Persistent work-log integration for Claude Code. Claude remembers what you've solved before — streams, beats, echoes.

skills.name: destreamed-propose
skills.description: Submit a plan, decision, or proposed rule to Destreamed with `needs_approval: true` so the human can Approve or Deny before you execute. Use whenever you're about to do something material that the user has not already explicitly told you to do — refactors, deletions, dependency bumps, schema changes, new memos.
headings: How to write the proposal echo
skills.description_zh: 对用户尚未明确授权的重要行动向Destreamed提交需审批的计划、决定或规则，由用户批准或拒绝后执行。

skills.name: destreamed-search
skills.description: Search Destreamed for prior solutions to a problem before re-solving it from scratch. Run this whenever the user reports an error, bug, regression, or unexpected behavior.
skills.description_zh: 遇到错误、缺陷或回归时搜索Destreamed既有解决方案，避免重复排查。

skills.name: destreamed-tune
skills.description: Run the Destreamed tuner workflow. Use at session start, when the user asks "what's on my plate", or whenever you're about to start work in a tracked project. Walks through tasks, memos, plan-approval, step logging, and task completion.
skills.description_zh: 运行Destreamed任务调优流程，查看待办、备忘录、计划审批、步骤记录和任务完成，适用于开始会话或跟踪项目。
